name: Sleepwalker
description: a tall thin wraith of the Rune Bridges asleep on its feet: a long pale grey hooded robe with faded cyan runes, arms held out stiffly in front of it, eyes closed in the hood, a little cyan sleep bubble at its face, floating with no feet

poses.stand: drifting upright, arms held out stiffly in front, eyes closed, asleep
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: floats asleep, swaying, the sleep bubble growing and shrinking

move.action: drifts forward to the right asleep, arms out stiffly, robe swaying, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
